reviews.text: Randy and his crew did an exceptional job resurfacing my pool. They also added new tile and my pool has never looked so beautiful! Add to that that he charged a lot less than my other bids. I would refer him to anyone who wants to renovate their pool. He has 30 years of experience and it shows.
reviews.author: Deborah balyeat

reviews.text: We had some serious issues with our pool, and Randy came in with solutions right away. He explained everything clearly and saved us money by fixing the problem the right way the first time. Our pool looks better than ever—highly recommend!
reviews.author: Charles Brown

reviews.text: Contacted Dallas Fort Worth Pool Renovations and spoke to Randy. Very responsive as he arranged to view our pool the next day. Even though they couldn’t fix our issue as it was outside their scope, I really appreciated his honesty and consult on effective ways to address the problem.  Would recommend them without reservation
reviews.author: Eric

reviews.text:
My pool was a mess!  Now all the work is done, it is pretty, it no longer leaks and I am swimming again! I'm happy! From everything I read and heard, resurfacing with fiberglass will last longer than with plaster, and it looks great.
Randy (the owner) is a great guy.  He was the only one of the people I contacted to actually show up and be on time for the estimate appointment. He kept in touch with me daily with updates and times he'd be at the house. We had a 3 day rain delay and he worked really hard to make up for lost time. He was in touch after the work was done to make sure everything was still good, which I appreciated. Thanks, Randy and the rest of the crew!
reviews.author: Clare Baker

reviews.text: These guys did a great job. They showed up on time every morning and cleaned up the mess that they made that day. Overall,totally satisfied.
reviews.author: Toni Pruett

reviews.text:
We hired DALLAS FORT WORTH POOL RENOVATIONS to get our house in order and “more modern” to sell before listing.. They did an amazing job! Our experience was better than I could have imagined!! The price was fair compared to other companies. Randy SAVED us a ton of money by staining the coping instead of having a whole replacement! The ideas are unique and perfect for our family and needs/wants. (And the new owners)
**AMAZING WORK**
reviews.author: Natalia Ribeiro

reviews.text: Fast and friendly.. got the job done.  Very reliable.. will call them again for my rent houses .  Spot on
reviews.author: Rhonda Halford

reviews.text: Amazing customer service. Professional and honest. Work done on time and on budget! Highly recommend Randy
reviews.author: Whitney worzer
